question: The 12th edition of the Ice Hockey Association of India’s (IHAI) National Ice Hockey Championship for Men (2023) was organised in _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **12th edition** of the Ice Hockey Association of India's (IHAI) National Ice Hockey Championship for Men (2023) was organized in **Ladakh**.
 
• The event saw participation from various teams across the country, showcasing the growing popularity of ice hockey in India.
 
• Ladakh, with its cold climate and natural ice rinks, provides an ideal setting for ice hockey and has been a significant contributor to the sport's development in India.
 
• The championship aims to promote ice hockey at the grassroots level and provide a platform for players to showcase their talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ladakh has been hosting the National Ice Hockey Championship for several years, leveraging its natural ice rinks and enthusiastic local participation.
 
• The Ice Hockey Association of India (IHAI) is the governing body for ice hockey in India and is responsible for organizing national championships and promoting the sport.
 
• Ice hockey is gaining popularity in India, particularly in regions with colder climates such as Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• The sport has received support from various organizations and the government to improve infrastructure and training facilities.
